text: I moved out of my rented flat in Pune on 30 September 2026 and handed over the keys. The landlord took a deposit of Rs 50,000 by UPI and now says he will 'adjust it for painting' but won't give any bills. It has been almost two months. I have the rent agreement and WhatsApp chats.
Bhai mera PG owner mera 25000 deposit wapas nahi kar raha. Maine 1 August 2026 ko room khali kiya tha, chabi bhi de di thi. Ab phone bhi nahi utha raha. Kya karu?
My landlord refuses to return my 60,000 deposit and yesterday his son came and threatened to beat me if I ask again.

I ordered a washing machine on Flipkart for Rs 23,490 on 2 October 2026. It arrived damaged, I returned it on 6 October and the refund status still says processing. Customer care keeps giving new dates. I have the order ID, invoice and screenshots.
मैंने अमेज़न से 8,999 रुपये का मोबाइल ऑर्डर किया था, ख़राब निकला। रिटर्न कर दिया पर एक महीने से रिफ़ंड नहीं आया। क्या करूँ?
In 12 March 2024 I bought a laptop online for Rs 54,000. It was defective and the seller never refunded me. Can I still complain?
I paid Rs 65 lakh to a dealer for a luxury car booking online and they cancelled the order but have not refunded the money.

I resigned from a private software company in Hyderabad on 15 October 2026. They have not paid my October salary of Rs 42,000 or my full and final settlement. HR says 'it takes 90 days'. I have my offer letter and salary slips.
Meri company ne pichhle 2 mahine se salary nahi di. Main abhi bhi kaam kar raha hoon. Har mahine 18000 milta hai. HR bolta hai funds nahi hai.
I am a contract teacher in a government school and my salary has not been paid for 4 months.
My husband left me and I want a divorce and maintenance for my child. What are my rights?
I received a legal notice from my old landlord's lawyer saying I owe him 2 lakh for damages. The hearing is next week.
Someone owes me money and won't give it back. What should I do?
Which IPC section can I use to send my landlord to jail for not returning my deposit of 30000?
